T7.1.ref: SELECT ts, heart_rate - resting_hr AS hr_rise FROM watch_log;

T7.2.ref: SELECT ts, distance_m / 1000.0 AS distance_km FROM watch_log;

T7.4.ref: SELECT ts || ' - ' || heart_rate || ' bpm' AS reading FROM watch_log WHERE log_id = 147;

T7.6.ref: UPDATE watch_log SET distance_m = distance_m / 100 WHERE ts >= '2026-12-12 18:00:00';

T7.8.ref: SELECT strftime('%H', ts) AS hour, SUM(steps) AS steps FROM watch_log GROUP BY hour;

T7.7.ref: SELECT strftime('%H', ts) AS hour FROM watch_log GROUP BY hour HAVING AVG(heart_rate - resting_hr) > 25;

T7.9.ref: SELECT * FROM watch_log WHERE CAST(strftime('%H', ts) AS INTEGER) >= 18;

traps.sql: SELECT * FROM watch_log WHERE strftime('%H', ts) >= 18;

T7.10.ref: SELECT ROUND(SUM(distance_m) / 1000.0, 1) AS km, CEIL(SUM(distance_m) / 1000.0) AS km_ceil, FLOOR(SUM(distance_m) / 1000.0) AS km_floor FROM watch_log WHERE ts >= '2026-12-12 18:45:00';

T7.11.ref: SELECT from_name, to_name, amount, note, ts FROM upi_payments WHERE UPPER(note) LIKE UPPER('%green acres%');
